title: Design and export scoped customer order evidence pages to Excel
description: A user opens a field designer from the existing customer-shipment report to select customer/original-currency/approved-order-count/known-single-unit-quantity/order-amount and explicit quantity/source evidence fields. Add narrow DTO/rules/controller files with a finite whitelist from ERP-228 evidence; preserve selected order, inclusive dates and stable Page>=1/PageSize1..200 slicing of the existing bounded authorized source. Catalog/preview/Excel each recheck identity/customer-shipment menu/fresh ERP scope; source caps fail closed, never accept client rows/amounts or cached scope. Server Total/TotalPages/PageOnly/context distinguish customer-currency rows from unique customers/orders and actual shipments. Always show original-currency/exact-unit/unknown/source context even when evidence columns are hidden; format unit-group evidence safely without duplicating monetary totals. Designer handles empty/invalid/denied/network states and preserves selection/date/page-size. Excel reruns preview and exports selected page fields in order with numeric known amounts/counts/quantities and explicit unknown cells distinct from zero, formula-safe text and normalized date/page/limit/source/currency/unit context; no cross-currency or cross-unit totals. Reuse existing menu and exporter helpers. Development only: reuse existing customer-shipment menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService and existing OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit; remain read-only. Preserve the verified existing sales-order source and identify it as approved-order evidence, never actual shipment or receipt evidence. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, permission expansion, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, direct table/business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, migrations, production SQL or real database execution, secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test. Any unavailable external environment acceptance must be explicitly environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Finite field/date/page validation and fresh menu/scope authorization drive the same bounded server evidence source, with stable selected-page customer/currency rows and server-derived coverage/unknown/unit metadata.

Existing customer-shipment entry opens a safe field/date/page designer preserving selection order and context, showing current-page/unknown/source evidence without actual shipment or cross-unit/currency claims.

Excel reruns authorization/validation and exports only selected page fields with typed known values, explicit unknown/null cells and formula-safe labels plus date/page/source-limit/currency/unit context; API/workbook/UI and source regressions plus safe Release build/test pass.
